spanish: Y vio la asna a mensajero de Jehová, y se echó debajo de Bilam, y se encendió nariz de Bilam, e hirió a la asna con el palo.

findings.issue: אַף is tagged as an affirmation particle (HTa) while lemma 639 is the noun; “nariz de Bilam” picks the construct-noun reading, drops the particle, and makes Bilam the possessor instead of the subject of the 3ms verb.
Qal וַיִּחַר is smoothed as reflexive “se encendió”.
Qal וַתִּרְבַּץ is smoothed as reflexive “se echó”.
תַּחַת is marked only as a preposition; “debajo de” locks the spatial “under” sense.

notes: Jehová, la asna, mensajero, the strike, and el palo match the other tokens; Bilam is not locked in PROPER_NAMES.md.
